<!-- pr-reviewer: 6482595d38c94798f2d116eb6e5a9ff5a1370a12 -->

**Needs changes before merge.** Two findings. The first is a real correctness bug with a one-line fix. The second is a one-line body fix for the new test suite.

What looks good
- Clean-room slice. No HSMWorks material, no new dependencies, no `.github/` / `build.rs` / scripts / `.cargo/` / `xtask/` changes, no snapshot PNGs and no golden changes. The new module carries a one-line provenance comment, and the decision record in `docs/decisions/2227-klartext-reader.md` gives the slice's reasoning.
- The reader reuses the RS-274 reader's arc resolver, section builder, numeric domain checks and the `peck_count` bound. No new logic is duplicated.
- Refusals name the function and the block number ("block N:" in the message); the slice refuses everything outside it by name.
- The round-trip test reads the recorded Klartext post golden back into the recorded CL stream. The degenerate suite (truncations, bad numbers, 200 k blocks, 3000 seeded mutations) is thorough.

Results merged with main (trial merge: clean, no hand edits; main 52d5ff6dc)
- Runner, merged tree: https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/actions/runs/46010295589
  - gcode build (`--no-run`): ok (12 s)
  - gcode suites: lib: ok
  - gcode suites: klartext: ok (24 tests per the PR body)
  - gcode suites: parse: ok (37 tests per the PR body)
  - `cargo clippy -p camcraft-gcode --all-targets -- -D warnings`: ok
- Locally (worktree, trial-merged, sccache): light lane - 6 steps, all ok (14.9 min): build (505 s), motion lib (295 s), adaptive_troch_island (47 s), adaptive_troch_neck (21 s), adaptive_troch_parallel (13 s), app pocket_pass_start (2 s).

Targeted tests
- Example catalog suites (`example_catalog*`): not run - the diff changes no post and no toolpath.
- Light lane: run locally, all steps ok.
- P7 slice, not a P1 under the safety floor: no targeted heavy step. No `<!-- heavy-wave -->` record (optional).

Requested before merge
1. A `STOP` block that carries `M0` or `M1` records the stop twice. `stop_block` records one `ProgramStop` (crates/gcode/src/klartext/blocks.rs:166) and `post_m` records another stop for each M0/M1 in the block (crates/gcode/src/klartext/exec.rs:211), so `STOP M1` records a `ProgramStop` and an `OptionalStop`, and `STOP M0` records two `ProgramStop`s. One stop per block is the rule. Fix: drop the extra `push_stop` in `stop_block` when the block carries M0/M1, or make `post_m` the only stop recorder for `STOP` blocks.
2. The new top-level test suite `crates/gcode/tests/klartext/` has no one-line reason in the PR body. AGENTS.md "New tests join a directory suite" requires a one-line reason for a new top-level test binary in `crates/*/tests/` (this crate already has the `tests/parse/` directory suite). Add the reason, or fold the klartext suite into the existing `parse/` directory suite.

Questions / notes (not blocking)
- `TOOL DEF <words>` is silently accepted, even with words after it (crates/gcode/src/klartext/blocks.rs:53). Consider a refusal or a documented no-op for the whole block.
- `crates/gcode/src/lib.rs:1` still describes only the RS-274 reader. Consider one line for the Klartext entry.
- Bare `STOP` is tested and correct; only the M-carrying form double-records.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: d9470782329eab63fa5481b1bbd0aacf887effbc -->

**Ready for the maintainer to merge.** Both findings from the earlier head (6482595d) are fixed at this head (d94707823); nothing new blocks.

What looks good
- Clean-room slice. No HSMWorks material, no new dependencies, no `build.rs` / `.github/` / scripts / `.cargo/` / `xtask/` changes, no snapshot PNGs, no golden changes. Each new module carries a one-line provenance comment, and `docs/decisions/2227-klartext-reader.md` gives the slice's reasoning, the refusal list and the dropped alternatives.
- The reader reuses the RS-274 reader's section builder, arc resolver, numeric domain checks and the peck bound. No logic is duplicated.
- Refusals name the function and the block number (`block N:`), and the message carries the physical line.
- The stop fix is correct: one `ProgramStop` per block, `M0` keeps its modal effect (spindle stop, coolant off), `M1` no longer weakens the unconditional stop, and the pinning test passes.
- The PR body now gives the one-line reason for the new top-level test binary, and the reason is sound: `tests/parse/` is the RS-274 reader suite; Klartext is a different input language with its own entry point (`parse_klartext`), so it gets its own directory suite.

Results merged with main (trial merge: clean, no hand edits; main 159ee3748; locally in `.claude/worktrees/cc-pr4361-review`, sccache on)
- Quick gate (`cargo xtask gate quick --base origin/main`): 4 steps, 0 failed.
  - gcode build (`--no-run`): ok (10 s)
  - gcode suites: lib: ok (1 s)
  - gcode suites: klartext: ok (25 tests, 2 s)
  - gcode suites: parse: ok (37 tests, 1 s)
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-gcode --all-targets -- -D warnings`: ok (1 m 17 s)
- Light lane (`cargo xtask gate light`): 6 steps, 0 failed (9.0 min). light build (release `--no-run`) 381 s; motion light: lib 70 s; adaptive_troch_island 50 s; adaptive_troch_neck 22 s; adaptive_troch_parallel 14 s; app light: pocket_pass_start 3 s.

Findings from the earlier head, verified fixed at this head
1. A `STOP` block carrying `M0` or `M1` recorded two stops — fixed in d94707823 (crates/gcode/src/klartext/blocks.rs:162): `stop_block` records one `ProgramStop`, filters `M0`/`M1` out of the list passed to `post_m` (crates/gcode/src/klartext/exec.rs:211), and keeps `M0`'s modal effect. The pinning test `klartext_stop_with_m0_or_m1_records_one_program_stop` (crates/gcode/tests/klartext/paths.rs:179) passes.
2. The new top-level test binary had no reason in the PR body — fixed: the "Tests" section now gives the one-line reason.

Targeted tests
- Example catalog suites (`example_catalog*`): not run - the diff changes no post and no toolpath.
- Light lane: run locally, all steps ok.
- P7 slice, not a P1 under the safety floor: no targeted heavy step. `cargo xtask gate heavy --base origin/main --dry-run` shows the diff reaches no heavy lane (0 steps reached, 123 skipped).
- No `<!-- heavy-wave: ... -->` record (optional).

Requested before merge
- None.

Questions / notes (not blocking)
- `TOOL DEF` is silently accepted, even with words after it (crates/gcode/src/klartext/blocks.rs:47). Consider a refusal or a documented no-op for the whole block.
- `crates/gcode/src/lib.rs:1` still describes only the RS-274 reader. Consider one line for the Klartext entry.
- Bare `STOP` and the M-carrying form both record one `ProgramStop` now; only M0 keeps its modal effect.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
